$comment: Private beta / dogfood triage labels (RC1-4.1, #3620). Sync to GitHub with `python3 scripts/sync_beta_labels.py`. A `wf:*` label's `workflow` is the exact option text of the Workflow dropdown in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/beta-feedback.yml. See docs/runbooks/BETA_TRIAGE.md.

labels.name: beta
labels.description: Reported by the private beta / dogfood cohort (RC1-4.1)

labels.name: triage:new
labels.description: Beta report not yet triaged

labels.name: triage:needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on the reporter for steps, version or a screenshot

labels.name: triage:accepted
labels.description: Confirmed and severity set; tracked by the RC1-4.2 burn-down

labels.name: triage:deferred
labels.description: Real, but not for v1.0.0-rc.1; the issue carries the written reason

labels.name: triage:duplicate
labels.description: Already reported; closed with a link to the original

labels.name: sev:critical
labels.description: Spine broken or data lost, no workaround. Blocks the RC tag

labels.name: sev:high
labels.description: A golden-path step fails or needs a workaround. Blocks the RC tag

labels.name: sev:medium
labels.description: Wrong or confusing, but the workflow completes

labels.name: sev:low
labels.description: Cosmetic, copy, or a suggestion

labels.name: wf:sign-in
labels.description: Beta workflow: signing in, creating or entering a tenant

labels.name: wf:import
labels.description: Beta workflow: importing a spec

labels.name: wf:lint
labels.description: Beta workflow: linting and the grade

labels.name: wf:studio
labels.description: Beta workflow: editing in Studio

labels.name: wf:review
labels.description: Beta workflow: comments, review requests, approval

labels.name: wf:publish
labels.description: Beta workflow: publishing and the publish gate

labels.name: wf:mock
labels.description: Beta workflow: turning a mock on and calling it

labels.name: wf:sdk
labels.description: Beta workflow: generating and downloading an SDK

labels.name: wf:browse
labels.description: Beta workflow: the public Browse page

labels.name: wf:other
labels.description: Beta workflow: anything outside the golden path
